name: Product Strategy & Lifecycle Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Product Strategy and Lifecycle Management, covering product discovery, PRDs (Product Requirement Documents), user story mapping, feature prioritization frameworks (RICE/Kano), product roadmap management, release planning, product analytics, and customer feedback loops.

checklists.name: Product Strategy & Lifecycle Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for product discovery, PRD completion, feature prioritization, and release planning.

items.statement: Product Discovery validates user pain points using customer interviews, survey data, or usage telemetry.
Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) define explicit user personas, functional specs, and acceptance criteria.
Feature backlog items are scored using RICE or Kano frameworks to justify roadmap placement.
Release plans specify scope, telemetry events, feature flag strategy, and rollback criteria.
Product analytics dashboards track post-launch feature adoption, funnel conversion, and retention metrics.

reviewGates.name: Product Management Director Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Product Management Director confirms that PRDs, roadmap prioritization, and telemetry plans satisfy product standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the product management package confirm feature value, requirement clarity, and release readiness?
